scientific_integrity: Formal algebraic identities checked; root legality and asymptotics proved analytically; finite numerical tests provide corroboration only. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise in a in (0,1); endpoint uniformity and other first-generation pencils unproved. Full text of relevant Garcia-Morato et al. (2019) inaccessible during comparison, leaving residual coverage risk.
title: Inverse-square parabolic accumulation of a first-generation critical-curve pencil
